diagnosis: The issue lies in how comments are handled. When a comment starts with ';', the tokenizer should skip to the end of the line or EOF but fails to do so properly, causing incorrect tokenization.

Function `skip` in lines 413-423 is intended to skip comments until EOL or EOF.
However, upon encountering EOF (line 421), it incorrectly ungets the character, disrupting proper tokenization.
